# Depth & Velocity

> Depth & Velocity is a methodology for new business development in the
> generative AI era, systematized by Satoshi Yamauchi (山内怜史), AI
> Strategist. It resolves the traditional trade-off between speed and depth
> by using AI, transforming the hypothesis-validation process of exploratory
> new business development into one that is both fast and deep. It also
> proposes "Project Brain" — a practice that prevents the process of new
> business development from becoming a black box, and instead turns the
> process itself into an asset — and advocates its introduction into new
> business development.

## Book Content

- [Manifesto (Japanese)](docs/ja/depth_and_velocity_JP.md): 方法論の全体像・日本語版
- [Manifesto (English)](docs/en/depth_and_velocity_EN.md): Full manifesto in English

## Key Facts (specific to this book)

- Core principle: new business development remains a human endeavor —
  Decision and Will remain MUST requirements even in the generative AI era
- The old approach (lengthy market research, polished slide decks, approval
  before building) is framed not as "too slow" but as "wrong"
- Proposes "Project Brain": turning the process of new business development
  itself into a reusable asset, preventing it from becoming a black box

## Author & Full Catalog

This book is one of 20+ open-source books by Satoshi Yamauchi (山内怜史),
AI Strategist & Business Designer at Sun Asterisk Inc., Founder of Leading.AI.
